description: This file defines a Swift module for discovering wide-area gateways via DNS and Tailscale status information. It includes data structures representing gateways, a discovery process utilizing DNS queries and Tailscale status parsing, and helper functions for network operations.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents information about a discovered wide-area gateway, including name, host, ports, and optional LAN/DNS details.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: Holds closures for obtaining Tailscale status and performing DNS dig operations, allowing injection of dependencies for testing or customization.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: Data structure for parsing the JSON output of Tailscale's status command.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main function that performs the discovery process, returning a list of discovered WideAreaGatewayBeacon objects.
